Subject: Starlite onboarding — invoice routing and early settlement option

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're excited to get Redwood set up as a paying customer. To speed onboarding, finance asked whether Redwood can: a) route invoices to AP@redwood.com with a PO reference and b) opt into an early settlement program (we offer 2% discount if paid within 10 days, or standard Net 30).

Could you confirm the preferred invoice lane, PO format, and whether you need any vendor forms from us (W-9, vendor onboarding spreadsheet)? If the early settlement is possible, please let us know any enrollment steps or paperwork required.

Attaching our onboarding form and W-9 for your records.

Attachments: [Starlite_W9.pdf (pdf)], [Starlite_Vendor-Onboarding-Form.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,

Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlite onboarding — invoice routing and early settlement option

Hi Ellie —

Thanks for sending over the docs and for the clear options. Quick notes from Redwood procurement:

- Invoice routing: please send invoices to ap@redwood.com and include the PO number on the invoice header. Our standard PO format is RWI-[6 digit number] (we will issue the PO once onboarding paperwork is complete).
- Vendor forms: we need the completed onboarding spreadsheet and a W-9 (you attached both — thank you). Please also confirm your remit address for ACH and whether you accept electronic invoicing (PDF by email is fine).
- Early settlement: we do have an early-pay enrollment program administered by Finance. We can evaluate a 2%/10 enrollment, but Finance requires a signed vendor early payment addendum and confirmation of bank details (ACH). Aditya (cc'd) will confirm the enrollment path.

Next steps: 
1) Ellie — can you confirm ACH remit details and return the vendor onboarding spreadsheet with the tax ID filled in?
2) Aditya — can you share the DocuSign/contract link for the early-pay addendum and confirm whether there's a central PO creation ETA?

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, Ellie Shaw <ellie@starlite.io>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starlite onboarding — invoice routing and early settlement option

Hi Kimberly / Ellie —

Thanks for the details. Finance is open to the 2%/10 early settlement but we run enrollment through our vendor financing partner (we call it EarlySettle). To proceed we need:

- Completed onboarding spreadsheet with legal entity and TIN (we need to match to bank records)
- Completed W-9 (received)
- ACH details (bank name, account type, last 4 digits) — we will not store full account numbers in email, only via the secure DocuSign form.

Ellie, I created the enrollment packet and vendor addendum in DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123def456 (placeholder link). Please sign the addendum and complete the secure bank info form; once returned, Finance will notify procurement and we can mark the vendor as "EarlySettle Opt-in" in our PO system.

POs: Procurement will issue the initial PO after the onboarding spreadsheet is complete. Expect an RWI- number in 48–72 business hours after we have the sheet.

Cc'ing AP for visibility.

—Aditya Rao
Sr. Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
